arguments.summary: No qualifying Dallas industrial refinance opportunities with executed, unextended maturities between 2026-09-01 and 2027-08-31 were found as of 2026-08-31. Most Dallas assets were re-designated to Seattle via executed amendments before the cutoff; others failed due to unconfirmed maturities, released/unknown loan status, stale owner verification, non-qualifying contact roles, or non-industrial asset type. Shortlist is empty. A prospects CSV and an XLSX with notes were generated.
limitations: Entity-level market amendments were applied across duplicates per instructions; if entity scoping differs, results may change.
Outstanding balances were not provided in the sources; preserved as null where applicable.
One base record (R5442) was published after the cutoff and was excluded on that basis.
If any team-page updates or extensions existed but were not included in the packet, eligibility could differ.
